name: Lumos LUS
summary:
Lumos LUS is the full-size bipedal humanoid family in Lumos Robotics' embodied-intelligence portfolio. It provides the human-shaped, legged branch of a broader range that also includes wheeled dual-arm, compact humanoid and wheeled-legged robots. Lumos positions this portfolio around bringing embodied AI into industrial applications.

This entry represents the LUS family rather than a single hardware generation. Model-specific dimensions, joint counts, payloads and runtime should therefore be taken from the corresponding LUS1 or LUS2 documentation when selecting a platform or comparing capabil
